These are the companion copy deck's own interpolation markers carried verbatim (companion 51.1), not unfilled authoring placeholders: each names a value the running product computes, and each is stated as such where it appears. No `TODO`, `TBD` or `<INSERT>` occurs.

The operator's instruction for this run also lifts the per-section caps explicitly.

D5 MINOR: the brief carries no sentence that contradicts the companion, but two documented departures narrow it. The companion's five console roles collapse to the two the permission boundary needs, and the companion's Section 53.3 claim that no enum substitution was necessary is false against this kit's enums -- `portfolio-agency` and `catalog-browse` are absent from tools/taxonomy_name.py, so the order was keyed to `local-services` and `crud-catalog`. Both are recorded in 00-decisions.md rather than silently honoured.

The brief was read end to end against all 24 checks. C2 is corroborated by G6's literal bijection over a 249-entry ledger, C3 by the route table against the API shapes table and the Data model, and D3 by G44.

B1 MINOR, two parts. The crud-catalog row fixes the db slot alone; this task declares P2-db-email, because the idea's terminal action files a lead into the studio's inbox and the companion commits the acknowledgement in the lead's own transaction, which is unobservable with no mail slot. The row also gives one baseline role, `user`; this task declares `editor` and `commercial`, because who may publish and who may read a candidate document are two different permission shapes the companion spends Sections 20.3 and 31.3 on. Both are recorded in 00-decisions.md.

S2 MINOR: 01-PRD lists eleven must-have features against S2's 3-6 bar. reference/G G.2.1 (B5) raises the cap to 6-10 when a companion document is supplied, and this task ships a 7,685-line PRD covering fifty-four sections; every added feature carries a grader in workflows.yaml. S2's bar is superseded for companion-backed tasks, and the eleventh feature is the public-surface group the companion spends five sections on.

S5 MINOR: 04-uiux carries no hex palette, no pixel type scale and no millisecond motion values. S5 predates the settled number rule (generate_instruction.md 'The number rule, DECIDED', A5, and tools/source_lint.py), which forbids a hex or a duration anywhere in the brief and carries colour as family and tone. The companion's seventeen hex anchors are carried as words, which source_lint verifies.

S6 MINOR: 05-schema states the one-lead-per-idempotency-key invariant and the append-only activity log as observable properties of the stored data rather than as named index or grant constructs. INV9 and G43 forbid naming the storage construct downstream, and the spec doc is written to the same register so the brief cannot inherit one.
BLD-004: no multi-stage build is used, so there is no stage to check for a leaked build secret.

CMP-020 MINOR: the `main` service carries `extra_hosts` and `ports` beyond `depends_on`. CMP-022 and docker_generator.md C12 require exactly those two keys; CMP-020 predates that rule and the two cannot both be satisfied. C12 wins: seven of fifteen shipped tasks omitted the mapping and lost every trial.
DEP-017: no host-resolved dependency artefact is copied into the image; every dependency is resolved in-build by pip and apt, per D24.

The ratio itself is not drawn at all, per reference/O O.5.
